title: Adding a new per-resource apiserver endpoint flag
answers: How do I add a flag to enable a new per-resource endpoint (like list-keys) in the standalone apiserver?
Why can't the standalone grafana-apiserver serve an endpoint that works when configured via ini?
body:
Symptom: a server configured by command-line flags (not an ini file) cannot serve a per-resource endpoint (e.g. list-keys) even though the ini equivalent exists and works.
Root cause: ExtraOptions had no bool field/flag mirroring the ini setting, so the standalone apiserver path never turned the feature on (pkg/services/apiserver/options/extra.go:ExtraOptions).
Fix pattern: add a new bool field to ExtraOptions mirroring the `[grafana-apiserver] enable_*` ini key, wire it with fs.BoolVar in ExtraOptions.AddFlags using a `--grafana-apiserver-enable-*-api` flag name, matching the ini default (on/off) based on how long the feature has shipped.
Constraints: keep each endpoint's flag separate (don't fold into an existing one) so deployments can toggle one endpoint without affecting others; new endpoints that haven't shipped long default to off.
applies: pkg/services/apiserver/options when adding a flag-controlled toggle for a new per-resource API endpoint
says: Endpoint works in config file but command-line flag doesn't enable it

search: Command-line-configured apiservers cannot serve per-resource endpoints (e.g., list-keys) unless a bool field in pkg/services/apiserver/options/extra.go:ExtraOptions mirrors the [grafana-apiserver] ini setting and is wired with fs.BoolVar using flag name `--grafana-apiserver-enable-*-api`. Each endpoint gets its own separate flag for independent toggling; new endpoints default to off unless the feature shipped long ago. Applies when adding flag-controlled per-resource API endpoint toggles. Paths: pkg/services/apiserver/options/extra.go:ExtraOptions, fs.BoolVar calls for flag binding.
